description:
MiniMax Music Cover — AI-powered song covers and style transfer.

Upload a reference track to extract its style, then generate a cover
with new lyrics and/or style direction.

reference_audio.description: Reference audio track for style transfer. 6s-6min, max 50MB.

prompt.description: Style and mood direction for the cover.
examples: Jazz arrangement with piano and soft drums
prompt.title: Prompt

lyrics.description: New lyrics for the cover with section tags. 10-1000 chars. If empty, uses reference lyrics.
lyrics.title: Lyrics
